questions.stem: A 6-year-old boy presents with a history of recurrent urinary tract infections. His blood pressure is normal, and physical examination is unremarkable. His mother reports that he had a febrile urinary tract infection six months ago. Renal ultrasonography showed no hydronephrosis or stones, but the pediatrician is concerned about renal cortical damage. Which of the following imaging studies is most appropriate for evaluating the child for renal cortical scarring?
